prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1462; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the intersection in Katy, Texas. Can you please state your full name for the record?

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you already have it on the claim file. I'm the driver of the blue sedan that was involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe what happened as you approached the intersection?

A: I had a green light heading east. I slowed a little because traffic was backed up, and then a pickup came through from the north side and hit my passenger side.

Q: Did you see the pickup before the impact?

A: Not really. I saw something move on the right, but I didn't have time to react. The impact was hard and my car spun partway around.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, and the airbags deployed on my side.

Q: Did you get checked out by anyone after the collision?

A: An ambulance took me to the hospital. They x-rayed my knee and told me it was badly bruised and possibly torn. I've been using crutches since then and I have a follow-up with an orthopedic doctor next week.

Q: Are you experiencing any other injuries or symptoms?

A: My neck is sore and my shoulder aches when I lift anything, but the knee is the worst. It swells up by the evening and I can't bend it all the way.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: Only that I was not speeding and I was doing what I was supposed to do. I'd like the other driver's insurance to cover my medical bills and the car repairs.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
